name: telaris-pcs
description: One MCP server for Telaris PCS: tasks, tags, orders, customers, products, custom reports and the Telaris documentation. Ships skills for the report engine, the search query engine and the template languages.

host.title: PCS hostname
host.description: Hostname of your Telaris PCS instance, without https:// — for example pcs.telaris.no

token.title: MCP auth key
token.description: Your personal auth key. Log in to PCS, open /mcp, and copy the key from the install command shown there. Treat it like a password.
